title: E2BSandboxEnvironment provider
description:
Implement E2B cloud sandbox environment provider at internal/sandbox/environment/e2b/.

Key deliverables:
- Sandbox create/pause/resume/destroy via E2B REST API
- File ops via filesystem API
- Commands via commands API with streaming
- Mocked HTTP tests
- Compliance test suite integration

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add01.md §5.3

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: R1 review complete — approved with revisions. 1 P1, 1 P2, 2 P3. P1: TOCTOU race in Pause/Resume/Destroy — state read under RLock then updated under Lock with HTTP call in between. Concurrent Destroy+Resume can leave state as Active after sandbox is destroyed server-side. Fix: hold write lock across lifecycle HTTP calls. P2: missing test for destroy-from-paused. See docs/reviews/aiag-0dou.2-r1-review-reviewer-sea.md
